Subject: Observability gateway egress & evidence routing — alignment request

Hi Mike / Osprey team,

Thanks again for the private deployment kickoff yesterday. Attached are the current drafts for how Redwood would route telemetry (logs/metrics/traces) from the private VPC to your SIEM-forwarder in your customer-managed account. Key asks:

- Can you confirm the proposed egress ports/IPs are acceptable for your ingress HEC endpoint? (see page 3 of PDF)
- Is the evidence bundle schema we outlined in "evidence_mapping_matrix.xlsx" compatible with your ingestion pipeline?
- Any blockers around signed-forwarder auth (mTLS + token) or additional headers you require?

Summary of design decisions included:
- Short-lived presigned upload for bulk evidence bundles (S3 -> pull by your ingestion job)
- Continuous syslog/HEC streaming from an in-cluster forwarder to a customer endpoint over TLS 1.3
- Tracing hooks: span-context headers injected at the service egress with sampling rate and per-route tagging

I attached a sample forwarder config for quick reference. We're aiming to have the evidence transfer and streaming validated before the infra cutover window (target next week). Can we get confirmation by EOD Thursday so we can lock the change window?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: redwood_vpc_obsv_egress_design_v1.pdf, evidence_mapping_matrix.xlsx, sample-forwarder-config.txt

From: Mike Turner <security@osprey-sys.com>
To: camila@redwood.ai
Cc: evidence@osprey-sys.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability gateway egress & evidence routing — alignment request

Hi Camila —

Appreciate the detailed packet. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Ports/IPs: the range you listed (443 outbound to our HEC cluster ips: 34.120.10.0/24, 34.120.11.0/24) looks fine. We'll whitelist those.
- Evidence schema: the matrix looks good; only ask is that the bundle manifest include a stable request_id (UUID) and a creation_ts in ISO-8601. We use the request_id for lineage in our chain-of-custody.
- Auth: mTLS is preferred. We can accept token-auth as a fallback but will need a periodic rotation schedule.

Two items to clarify:
1) For the S3 presigned model, will you push notification events to our ingestion queue once a bundle is available? If not, we'll need a polling interval to avoid long ingest lag.
2) Tracing headers: we need to ensure you don't drop or rewrite our internal span-tags. Can you confirm all span baggage keys are passed through unchanged?

We can do a brief tech sync tomorrow at 10am PT to walk the config and do a handshake test. If that works for you we'll plan to run a small end-to-end validation (one bundle + continuous stream) on Friday.

—Mike Turner
Security Engineering Lead | Osprey Systems
security@osprey-sys.com
+1 206-555-9120
